title: Rule Four Was Scratched Off
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Rule four was scratched off the staff sheet.
first_visual: A rules sheet taped inside a pharmacy hatch; rules 1, 2, 3, 5 typed, rule 4 gouged out.

beats.vo: Rule four was scratched off the staff sheet.

beats.visual: Ivy unlocks the hatch at midnight; reads the sheet.
beats.vo: First night on the overnight hatch.

beats.visual: A customer slides a prescription through the slot; Ivy serves.
beats.vo: One: hatch locked after midnight. Two: slot only.

beats.visual: Ivy realises her back is to the stockroom; turns; the door is slightly ajar.
beats.vo: Three: never stand with your back to the stockroom.

beats.visual: Under the counter, she finds words scratched in steel.
beats.vo: Rule four was under the counter.

beats.visual: Scratched text: 4. THE HATCH ISN'T TO KEEP THEM OUT. IT'S TO KEEP YOU IN.
beats.vo: 'The hatch isn't to keep them out.'

beats.visual: Ivy tries the front door: bolted from outside; three night customers stand calmly watching.
Key moment: the stockroom door swings open behind her; lamp eyes on the top shelf; a note slides through the slot.
beats.vo: 'Sorry, love. Someone has to work nights.'

ending: Lamp eyes on the top stockroom shelf. A note slides through the slot: 'Sorry, love. Someone has to work nights.'

concept: On her first overnight shift, Ivy finds the staff rules missing rule four. She finds it scratched into the counter: the hatch isn't to keep them out, it's to keep you in. The night worker is the one being kept, with something in the stockroom.
